# Changelog

Together AI changelog for serverless and dedicated serving.

## New dedicated endpoint models

Dedicated-only launches must not enter the serverless catalogue.

- `togethercomputer/dedicated-changelog-only`
- `mixedbread-ai/mxbai-rerank-large-v2`

## New serverless models

- `togethercomputer/changelog-launch-only`

## Model deprecations

The following models will be removed from serverless on September 14, 2026.

- `openai/gpt-oss-20b` Recommended replacement: `openai/gpt-oss-120b`

## Model redirects

| Original model | Redirects to |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3` | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1` |
